SELECT oi.order_info_id, oi.user_id, op.name AS person_name, op.email AS person_email, op.phone AS person_phone, oi2.product_id AS item_product_id, oi2.product_name AS item_product_name, oi2.quantity AS item_quantity, oi2.price_per_unit AS item_price_per_unit, p.payment_id, p.order_info_id AS payment_order_info_id, p.payment_number, p.amount AS payment_amount, p.payment_method, p.created_at AS payment_created_at FROM order_info oi JOIN order_item oi2 ON oi.order_info_id = oi2.order_info_id JOIN order_person op ON oi.order_info_id = op.order_info_id JOIN payment p ON oi.order_info_id = p.order_info_id WHERE oi.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY oi.order_info_id DESC, p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
